milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The lever is placed at spawn-relative (7, 1, 7) inside a stone brick building. The player must navigate near the lever (within 8 blocks, which means being inside or at the entrance of the building) and face toward it (within 60 degrees). This correctly models 'player can see the lever' without requiring them to stand on an exact spot.
